quarterly_data.signal: Adobe's 10-K: remaining performance obligations were approximately $22.52 billion as of November 28, 2025, up 13% from $19.96 billion as of November 29, 2024; non-cancellable committed funds under some enterprise customer agreements were approximately 4% of the total, and approximately 65% of the remaining performance obligations excluding those agreements are expected to be recognized over the next 12 months. Non-cancellable unconditional purchase obligations were $6.82 billion as of November 28, 2025, primarily relating to contracts with vendors for third-party hosting and data center services.
quarterly_data.figure: RPO $22.52 billion as of November 28, 2025 (+13% from $19.96 billion as of November 29, 2024); ~65% (excluding committed-funds agreements) recognized over next 12 months; non-cancellable purchase obligations $6.82 billion as of November 28, 2025, primarily third-party hosting and data center services
